verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I speak to the children of Israel, and I say to them: These are the ones whom Jehovah has called upon from among the holy ones. They are indeed those who are worthy of being called upon.
verses.3: Six days shall be employed for work. But on the seventh day, it shall be a day of rest. All work must cease on that day. The Sabbath is a day for God in all your activities.
verses.4: These are the ordinances of the LORD, which were commanded to be observed during those days.
verses.5: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between Erev Pesach and Yohav.
verses.6: And on the fifteenth day of this month, there is a holiday called “Hag HaMatsot”. During these seven days, people eat matsot.
verses.7: On that first day, it shall be a day of sacred rest for you. You shall not do any work at all.
verses.8: And you shall bring one woman before Jehovah for seven days, on the seventh day, from the time of the call to sanctification. All work must be stopped on that day.
verses.9: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.10: I spoke to the children of Israel and said to them, “When you enter the land that I give you, you must gather its crops. Then you must bring the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.”
verses.11: And he shall hold the scroll before Jehovah, so that you may be able to read it from the evening of Shabbat. The priest shall hold it there.
verses.12: And on the day of your circumcision, you made the foreskin of the boy pure in the year after his birth, for Jehovah’s sake.
verses.13: And from its aroma, there are twenty-four sicles of honey. It smells wonderful and is a delicious spice. It’s also used in making wine.
verses.14: And Lehem, Kali, and Karmel shall not be eaten until today. Only when you bring your sacrifices to your gods will they be accepted as a permanent law for your generations in all your places of worship.
verses.15: And you shall remember this from the evening of Shabbat, from the day when you brought back the broken pieces. On those seven Sabbaths, let it be remembered.
verses.16: Until the eighth Sabbath of Shabbat, they shall count fifty days. Then they shall offer a new sacrifice to Jehovah.
verses.17: From your seats, bring out some bread. Divide it into two portions of twelve loaves each. These loaves should be hot and ready to be eaten in the altar before Jehovah.
verses.18: And you shall bring before the altar seven young bullocks and one ram, and two rams without blemish. They shall be offered as sacrifices to Jehovah. And their offering and their sacrifice shall be a woman who is pleasing to Jehovah.
verses.19: And they made one horn for sin, and two others as offerings to the gods.
verses.20: And the priest shall place them on the bread of consecration, before Jehovah. They shall be used as two sacred vessels for Jehovah’s use by the priest.
verses.21: And today, when you call it “holy day,” it will become a time for you to do nothing that is forbidden by God’s laws. You must not do anything that violates these laws during this day.
verses.22: And in your harvest, do not waste a single grain from your fields. Do not give away any of your crops to the poor. I, the LORD your God, will take care of them.
verses.23: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.24: I speak to the children of Israel, saying: In the seventh month, on the first day of that month, there shall be for you a Sabbath. It shall be a reminder of the covenant made with you.
verses.25: Do not do any work. Do not also offer sacrifices to Jehovah.
verses.26: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.27: But on the twentieth day of the seventh month, which is the day of Pentecost, it will be a holy day for you. You should set aside your hearts and devote yourselves to Jehovah.
verses.28: And no work shall be done on this very day, for it is a day of judgment for you before Jehovah your God.
verses.29: For every soul that does not respond today, it will be marked as belonging to its own people.
verses.30: And every soul that does any work on this very day, I will destroy that soul from among My people.
verses.31: No work shall be done that is forbidden by eternal law, in all your places of worship.
verses.32: The Sabbath of your Lord is for you. You should observe it on the ninth day of each month, from evening to evening. You shall keep this Sabbath day.
verses.33: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.34: I said to the children of Israel, “On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, this will be the day of celebration. It is a seven-day festival for Jehovah.”
verses.35: On that first day, it is a sacred day; no work shall be done at all.
verses.36: For seven days, they must offer a female animal to Yahweh on the eighth day. This is a sacred day for you. When you offer a female animal to Yahweh, all other offerings are not allowed.
verses.37: These are the offerings that Jehovah commands be offered as sacrifices. They are offered in accordance with the sacred laws, so that women may offer these offerings to Jehovah. These offerings include grain, incense, and offerings for the day itself.
verses.38: Along with the offerings you give to Jehovah, along with all your sacrifices and offerings that you give to Him.
verses.39: But on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you gather together all the people from all over the land, you shall celebrate the feast of Yahweh for seven days. On the first day it will be a Sabbath, and on the eighth day it will also be a Sabbath.
verses.40: And on that first day, you shall take from the tree of life fruit, as well as branches of the tree of life and leaves from the tree of life. And you shall rejoice before Jehovah your God for seven days.
verses.41: And celebrate it as a holiday for Jehovah for seven days each year. This is a worldwide tradition for your generations. Celebrate it in the seventh month of the year.
verses.42: In the tabernacles, they shall dwell for seven days. All of Israel shall dwell in the tabernacles.
verses.43: So that your ancestors may know that I, the LORD your God, am who has placed the children of Israel in their places when I brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.44: And Moses spoke the words of Jehovah to the children of Israel.
